rv.q: She purely took my breath away.
Kudos to Fleetwood-Jordain Theatre for taking on a provocative theater experience and doing it so well.
"American Son" climbs the emotional ladder steadily until all that is left on stage is a narrowing spotlight highlighting a world of eternal grief.
In this production of American Son, I felt an emotional disconnect.
"American Son” is a story about an appalling reality that we face every day in our society.

cn.t: This powerhouse production tackles racial tension with muscular performances that leave audiences stunned, though the heavy subject matter and complex character dynamics make for an emotionally demanding experience.
